name: Universal Declaration of Human Rights adopted
short_desc: The UN General Assembly adopts a declaration setting out a common international standard of fundamental human rights.
date_note: Adopted in Paris on 10 December 1948 as General Assembly resolution 217 A (III). This was a declaration, rather than a binding treaty entering into force.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A major postwar rights framework with continuing influence beyond any single national constitution. Evidence and date rationale: Adopted in Paris on 10 December 1948 as General Assembly resolution 217 A (III). This records adoption of a declaration, not a binding treaty coming into force or the first appearance of ideas about rights. Primary evidence: https://www.un.org/en/about-us/universal-declaration-of-human-rights. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background. Remains review, not comprehensive factual approval.
